services.name: Full Product Team as a Service
services.description: Silxor becomes the senior product organization behind founders and companies who need to move from concept to production and scale. One accountable partner covers architecture, product, design, engineering, and testing, so you never have to find, vet, hire, and manage separate specialists.
services.summary: A complete senior product team behind your idea, not just developers.

services.name: IT Strategy & Advisory
services.description: We help enterprise and corporate leadership teams plan their entire IT estate, from business strategy and governance to infrastructure, networking, end user services, security and applications. Every recommendation is grounded in what we can design, build, migrate and operate.
services.summary: Decisions on architecture, platforms, and risk made with senior engineering judgment.

services.name: Infrastructure, Networking & Cloud
services.description: We design, build, migrate and operate on premises, hybrid and cloud environments for enterprise and corporate clients. Data center, compute, storage, networking, virtualization and cloud platforms are designed as one coherent estate, with security and recovery considered from the start.
services.summary: Resilient sovereign, private, and hybrid platforms engineered to stay up.

services.name: Cybersecurity
services.description: We build security architecture around identity, segmentation, and evidence, then align the program to the control frameworks your regulators and customers expect.
services.summary: Security architecture and evidence that hold up to auditors and attackers.

services.name: Managed IT & End User Services
services.description: We operate and support enterprise IT across end user devices, workplace platforms, networks, data centers, cloud and applications. Monitoring, service management, patching and lifecycle planning sit under one accountable team. Coverage, response targets and escalation paths are agreed per engagement.
services.summary: Senior ownership of your platform after go live, under agreed SLA tiers.

services.name: Private AI & AI Platforms
services.description: We build AI platforms that run on client dedicated infrastructure, so sensitive data is not sent to third party model providers. Governance, access, and auditability are part of the design.
services.summary: AI capability inside your own environment, with your data staying there.

services.name: Identity & Access Management
services.description: We design, implement, migrate and operate identity services across workforce, customer, privileged and machine access. Identity architecture, lifecycle governance, directories, federation and strong authentication span on premises, hybrid and cloud environments.
services.summary: Govern human, customer, privileged and machine identities across your enterprise.

services.name: Custom Software Engineering
services.description: We design, build, integrate and operate custom software for enterprise and corporate clients. Architecture, user experience, engineering, quality assurance and delivery cover web, mobile, internal platforms, APIs and private AI integrations.
services.summary: Custom applications, platforms and integrations built around your business.

services.name: Custom Hardware, Embedded & IoT
services.description: We scope, design and build custom hardware, embedded systems and IoT solutions with the software and infrastructure they depend on. Electronics, firmware, connectivity and enterprise integration are considered together from prototype through deployment and operations.
services.summary: Connected hardware and embedded systems engineered alongside your software.
